name: Planned dates by location and zone
summary: Planned start and finish dates for each stage, per structure or zone, set by import or edited by hand, and exported as CSV.

roles.note: The seed catalog has no schedule-specific permission strings. Who may upload or edit schedules is unknown (DEC-010 covers related edit rights).

nfr.statement: Largest number of stage × location date rows a project's plan must support.
nfr.open_question: How many structures, zones and stages do the largest scheduled projects have?

requirements.title: Planned dates are stored per stage and location
requirements.statement: Planned start and finish dates are stored on each stage, per structure or per zone. Manual bulk edits and imported schedules write the same dates, so whichever runs last wins.
open_checks: Bulk writes aren't shown to be all-or-nothing across validation, logs and other derived data

acceptance_criteria.given: An imported plan gives Drywall-Framing on floor 2 the dates 1–20 March
acceptance_criteria.when: A user edits that row by hand to 5–25 March
acceptance_criteria.then: The stored plan is 5–25 March until the next import

requirements.title: Zone-level planned dates
requirements.statement: Schedule uploads can include start and end dates per zone. CSV downloads always reflect the current zone structure, showing NA for levels with no zones. An upload is rejected if any zone's dates fall outside its level's dates.

sources.title: Direct code reads during USER migration (2026-10-29)

acceptance_criteria.given: A CSV with zone-level dates for floor 2
acceptance_criteria.then: The zone plan for floor 2 is updated

acceptance_criteria.when: A CSV gives one of its zones 25 March – 10 April
